action.screen: Settings > Sounds and Vibration > Ringtone
steps: Select Ringtone to view available options.

action.screen: Settings > Battery
steps: Review the battery usage details and available power management options.

action.screen: Settings > Notifications > Background activity
steps: Select Background activity to view filtering options.

action.screen: Settings > Network & Internet > More > USB tethering
steps: Tap on USB tethering to view the connection options.

action.screen: Settings > General Management > System Navigation > Keyboard Settings > Symbol Panel
steps: Choose the option to keep the symbol panel open.

action.screen: Settings > Security > USB debugging
steps: Turn on the option to block USB connections while the screen is locked.

action.screen: Settings > Notifications > Advanced settings > Show brief pop-ups even while screen is off
steps: Tap on Show brief pop-ups even while screen is off.

action.screen: Settings > Battery > Battery Protection
steps: Turn on the switch to limit charging to 85%.

action.screen: Settings > Accessibility > TalkBack > Verbosity
steps: Tap on Verbosity to choose your preferred level of spoken detail.

action.screen: Settings > Accessibility > Display > High contrast fonts
steps: Tap on High contrast fonts to view the options.

action.screen: Settings > System > Languages & input > On-screen keyboard
steps: Enable the option to show the keyboard when a physical keyboard is connected.

action.screen: Settings > Display > Screen Recording > Selfie Video Size
steps: Tap on Selfie Video Size to adjust the overlay dimensions.

action.screen: Settings > Accessibility > Hearing Aid Compatibility
steps: Toggle the switch to enable the feature.

action.screen: Settings > Network & Internet > SIM manager
steps: Toggle the switch to enable the feature.

action.screen: Settings > Display > Extra dim
steps: Toggle the switch to enable the feature.

action.screen: Settings > General > Date & Time > Automatic Time Zone
steps: Turn on the Automatic Time Zone switch.

action.screen: Settings > Network & Internet > Mobile Network > Mobile Data
steps: Toggle the switch next to Mobile Data to the on position.

action.screen: Settings > Advanced features > S Pen > Quick notes
steps: Toggle the switch to enable the feature.

action.screen: Settings > Apps > Show Device Care on Apps screen
steps: Locate the option labeled 'Show Device Care on Apps screen'.
Turn off the toggle switch to hide the icon.

action.screen: Settings > Sound & Vibration > Vibration > Charging Vibration
steps: Locate the Charging Vibration option and toggle it off.

action.screen: Settings > Display > Adaptive Display
steps: Toggle off the switch to disable automatic color adjustment.

action.screen: Settings > Sound & Vibration > Keypad Tones
steps: Toggle the switch to off to silence the dial pad sounds.

action.screen: Settings > Connected devices > Link to Windows
steps: Toggle the switch to the off position.

action.screen: Settings > Sound & Vibration > Camera Feedback
